description: Two dancers take a ballroom hold and turn together with a buzz step.

walkthrough.line: Close into a ballroom hold with {who}, right hips together, and buzz round.
walkthrough.teach: Step in to {who} and close into a ballroom hold, right hips together: the lark's right hand on the robin's back, the lark's left hand in the robin's right out to the side. Buzz round with your weight on the inside foot, leaning a little away from each other. Open out side by side, lark on the left.
